title: Pretty little rug
text: Pretty little rug. Pretty little rug, not of the highest quality (but the price is right). Rating it four stars as it was shipped tightly rolled in plastic and I have now had it on my kitchen floor for almost a week with weights on all four corners and I still can't get the curl out of it. Not sure how long I will need to do this, probably because of the material it is made of it holds the packaging curl tightly. I will say the colors are nice and work well with my beige kitchen. Just not thrilled with how long it is taking to lay flat. They should have a better way of shipping these.

description: Distinguished by its unprecedented watercolor design, the Madeline collection features a series of gorgeous, show-stopping rugs at an unbeatable price. Power-loomed of 100% polypropylene in Egypt, Madeline's color space-dyeing technique gradates the bold and vibrant colors throughout the rug to create a stunning rendition of popular watercolor paintings.
